sentences.text:
Mrityunjay Kumar Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3
Others on 13 September, 2024

Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150360-Db
Court No. - 42
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 15904 of 2024
Petitioner :- Mrityunjay Kumar Gupta And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Amrita Kashyap,Subham Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Akhilesh Kumar Ojha,G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mohd. Aadil holding brief of Ms. Amrita Kashyap, learned counsel for the petitioners,
Sri Akhilesh Kumar Ojha, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Ajay Kumar Sharma, learned
A.G.A. appearing for the State respondents.
2.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 22.06.2024 registered as Case Crime No.195 of 2024, under Section- 363 I.P.C., Police Station - Tamkuhraj, District- Kushinagar, and for a direction to the respondents not Mrityunjay Kumar Gupta And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22199387/
1 to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Information Report.

3.Submission of learned counsel for the petitioners is that as per Aadhar Card, date of birth of petitioner no. 3, Reshmi Kumari Chaurasiya is 24.07.2004 and date of birth of petitioner no. 1,
Mrityunjay Kumar Gupta is 01.01.1996 and as such, the petitioner no. 1 and 3 are major and they have married on their sweet will, therefore no offence as alleged has been committed.
By drawing attention to Annexure-5 to the petition, it is submitted that they have also applied for registration of their marriage.
It is further submitted that even the consent of the victim is material evidence.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the informant submits against the petitioner no.1 that one case under Section 363, 366, 506, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act is already pending and he has enticed away the daughter of the informant aged about 15 years and she is aged about 15 years as per High School Certificate.
Learned A.G.A. submits that as per High School Certificate her date of birth is 24.07.2009 and she is a minor.

He also pointed out that petitioner no.1 has criminal history of three cases and apart from the case noted above, he has two cases under the provisions of Cow Slaughter Act.
5.
In the facts and circumstances of the present case, we find that a cognizable offence is made out.

6. Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
